notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ» : the asker سماعة is written first; the one asked is the Imam that the previous report 3830 names as the last link of its chain («عن أبي عبد الله»), taken over as inherited (al-Faqih rule).

«وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ» : the asker سماعة is written first; the one asked is the Imam that the previous report 3830 names as the last link of its chain («عن أبي عبد الله»), taken over as inherited (al-Faqih rule).

«وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ»: the asker is the link; «سأله» points at the Imam of prev1, whose chain writes «عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»; the Imam is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2 as the al-Faqih example)
